summary: The agent provides a structurally sound LightGBM pipeline with robust CV and categorical handling. However, it peeks at the test set when deciding how to cast boolean features. More critically, it trains the model on a log-transformed target while the task requires optimizing RMSE on the original scale, and it averages test predictions in the log space. Both of these mathematical flaws will systematically under-predict large values and significantly degrade the final RMSE.
